name: Doxycycline
description: Tetracycline-class antibiotic taken by mouth; a low-strength 40 mg form is used for rosacea

note.text: The standard label says doxycycline may be useful adjunctive therapy in severe acne, not a stand-alone acne approval.

bullets: **Inhibits bacterial protein synthesis** by binding the 30S ribosomal subunit
**Bacteriostatic** against a broad range of bacteria, per the label
**In rosacea,** Oracea's mechanism is unknown, per its label

practical.pharmacokinetics: Peak at 2 hours (200 mg); excreted unchanged in urine, feces
practical.soldAs: Prescription capsules and tablets (Vibramycin, Oracea, generics)
practical.monitored: Sun sensitivity, headache or vision (intracranial pressure)

regulatory.text: Authorised nationally in all 27 EU countries

references: FDA, Doxycycline hyclate capsules prescribing information (DailyMed), Oct 2025
Skidmore et al., Arch Dermatol, low-dose doxycycline in acne, Apr 2003
